d:
Bihar ke rohtas jile ke bikramganj shahar men budhvar ko dinadhare huee golibari se ilake men dahshat phail gaee. dehri rod sthit bas staind ke samip do guton ke bich kisi bat ko lekar shuru huee kahasuni dekhte hi dekhte hinsak jharap men badal gaee aur donon or se kaee raund goliyan chalne lagin. is ghatna men sarak se gujar raha ek nirdosh rahgir goli ki chapet men aakar ganbhir rup se ghayal ho gaya.
Kam par ja rahe pentar dharmendr pandit ko lagi goli, karuna hospital men ilaj jari
